title: ID0406998-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/S3 300000004055] EmergencyStopButton_SF2
description:
Reported behavior/ issue:
There is “EmergencyStopButton_SF2” error but it is not pressed
Root cause:
Solution:  There was a wrong wiring in XD23 6:D and 8:D.
